verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is an autonomous research agent. It takes a topic, researches the web for hours and generates reports and slides. It does not operate on or write to a user's production systems or data, so a sandbox-versus-production testing axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows a sandbox, test mode or production-data integration that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
